items.information:
## Portugues:

Pedimos que os competidores inscritos levem no máximo **1 ACOMPANHANTE** por questões de capacidade de pessoas no local.
Por ser uma competição de inscrição gratuíta, por favor pedidmos que se inscreve se tiver certeza que irá. Caso se inscreva e não possa ir, favor se desinscrever para dar chance aos outros inscritos.

## English

We ask that registered competitors take a maximum of **1 COMPANION**, due to capacity issues at the venue.
As this is a free entry competition, please enter if you are sure you will. If you sign up and can't make it, please unsubscribe to give other competitors a chance to go.

items.information:
**German**
Willkommen in Köln! Endlich ist es wieder soweit - eine Speedcubing-Competition in unserer Stadt! Wir freuen uns auf dieses Wochenende mit vielen interessanten Events.

Am 11. November (Samstag) ist in Köln der Beginn des Karnevals. Rechnet mit Verspätungen des Nahverkehrs!


**English**
Welcome to Cologne! The time has finally come again - a Speedcubing-Competition in our city! We are looking forward to this weekend with many interesting events.

On November 11th (Saturday), Cologne Carnival is set to start. Expect delays in public transportation!

For questions regarding deadlines, registrations, and the competition waitlist, please see the [Registration and Waistlist Info](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UtahChampionship2023#30564-registration-and-waitlist-info) tab. 


Go to our [link tree](https://linktr.ee/utahcubing) to find links to our Facebook group , Instagram page, and website, as well as the Rockies Discord Server, to be notified when local competitions are announced and to keep in touch with cubers in the area!
